title: Diabetes mellitus: type, complications and medication status
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's diabetes, its complications and related long-term drug use.
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for diabetes management.

HPI
The patient is a 58-year-old male presenting for a routine follow-up regarding his type 2 diabetes. He reports that he has been stable on his current regimen and denies any acute concerns or recent illness. He continues to take an oral hypoglycemic medication daily. He reports consistent adherence to his prescribed treatment plan.

Medication List
Metformin 500mg BID

Exam
The patient appears well-nourished and in no acute distress. Physical examination is unremarkable. Skin is intact without lesions. Pulse is regular.

Assessment
1. Type 2 diabetes mellitus without complications.

Plan
The patient will continue his current dose of metformin. We will monitor his laboratory values at the next visit. The patient was instructed to continue his current treatment and will return in three months for a follow-up.
explanations: No complication is documented: type 2 diabetes without complications.
Long-term oral hypoglycemic use: add Z79.84.

distractors.why: Nothing in the note documents hyperglycemia or poor control.
Z79.84 captures long-term oral hypoglycemic use.
